description: Remove a previously-imported Pathrule pattern bundle in one call — the reverse of pathrule_import_pattern. The pattern definition is the manifest, so this finds and deletes the memories/rules/skills whose titles match the pattern's pieces. Pass the SAME `node_path` base that was used at import (omit if the bundle used the pattern's own paths). Pieces that are not found are reported, not errors (idempotent). Relay the returned human_message.

node_path.description: The base path the bundle was imported under. Must match the import to locate the pieces.

slug.description: Pattern slug — the part after 'package:' in ::pathrule:package:<slug>.

verbose.description: Set true for per-piece detail. Default false (compact summary).

name: pathrule_remove_pattern
title: Remove Pattern
